## What managing Lakeview takes.

### Wrigleyville event-day operations
Buildings near Wrigley Field live with 81 home games plus concerts and street festivals. We write event-day parking, trash, noise, and security logistics into the operating calendar so boards are not improvising every summer weekend.

### The Belmont Harbor high-rise corridor
Lakeview East's towers along Lake Shore Drive carry true lakefront exposure, wind-driven rain, masonry critical examinations, riser and window replacement cycles, and we build reserve plans around those capital rhythms.

### Northalsted and Southport walk-ups
From Northalsted's well-kept vintage condo buildings to courtyard walk-ups off the Southport Corridor, most Lakeview associations are small to mid-size communities that want responsive, personal management rather than a national call center.

## Lakeview boards ask us first.

### Do you manage condo buildings near Wrigley Field?
Yes. Wrigleyville associations face conditions most Chicago buildings never see, game-day parking and traffic, event noise, and heavy seasonal foot traffic. We prepare an event-season operating plan for each Wrigleyville client so the building runs smoothly from opening day through the last night game.

### Does CenterPoint serve Boystown (Northalsted) and Lakeview East?
Yes. Northalsted and Lakeview East are part of our Lakeview service area (ZIPs 60657 and 60613), including the high-rise corridor near Belmont Harbor. Associations there get the same dedicated manager, transparent reporting, and 24/7 live emergency response as every CenterPoint community.

### Does CenterPoint manage associations in Lakeview?
Yes. CenterPoint Association Management provides condominium, HOA, and townhome association management in Lakeview, Chicago (ZIP 60613, 60657). Every association gets a dedicated manager, monthly financial reporting, and board support grounded in Illinois association law.

### How much does association management cost in Lakeview?
Management starts at $20 per unit per month, quoted as a flat monthly fee based on your association's size, building systems, financial complexity, and service scope. It is never a percentage of your budget. See [pricing](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/pricing) for what drives the fee.

### How does a Lakeview association switch to CenterPoint?
Plan on a managed 30 to 60 day transition after your board gives notice under its current contract. We retrieve records from the outgoing manager, set up banking and vendor relationships, notify owners, and open board and resident access. ### How should a Lakeview board compare management companies?
Compare at least three firms on the same terms: an active Illinois community association management firm license, a licensed manager, a flat monthly fee in writing, after-hours emergency coverage, and a written transition plan.
